item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 29/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cloudier with one or two light rain patches over the region. It will remain cool in the morning and at night. With the easterly airstream moderating over the weekend. It will be mild during the day and relatively humid over the coastal areas. A cold front is expected to reach the coast of southern China later on Sunday to Monday at first. There will be one or two rain patches over the region. The associated winter monsoon will bring cold and dry weather over the region in the following couple of days.
